mm7/wizh-a.name: wizh-a
mm7/wizh-a.material: brown wall of rounded flat cobble stones set in pale tan mortar, with the upper part of a hanging banner of muted greyish slate-blue cloth, not saturated, hung from a rod, bordered on both sides by dark maroon-red and black interlaced knot strips, embroidered with a pale gold scroll crossed with a wand and a pale gold serpent; copy the composition exactly

notes.2: the cloth is a dusky violet-tinged slate blue with no green or cyan in it, the same tone as the sharp lower banner part below the bottom edge, which it continues seamlessly; the border strips are dark maroon-red knotwork on near-black
